lore: Salvage from every island in the census goes under the hammer on the quay tonight, one lot at a time. Auctioneer Barnaby takes sealed bids. Your only rival is the Broker, a creature of habit: half the lot's worth, and three coins more for every lot it has lost to you. Ties go to the Broker. Win the most value you can before your purse runs dry.

lines.shrewd: Sold, and to the sharpest bidder on the quay. Not a coin wasted against that Broker.
lines.fair: A respectable haul. But every lot you snatched early made the Broker hungrier later.
lines.fleeced: The Broker's laughing all the way to the counting house. Let the small lots go, and save for the prizes.
